name: juzpost
description: JuzPost is a free social media scheduler with low-cost paid plans. Schedule and publish posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress from your AI agent. Bundles the JuzPost skills and the hosted JuzPost MCP server.

juzpost.description: Official JuzPost MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Signs in with OAuth on first use: Gemini CLI opens a browser to sign in to JuzPost and pick a workspace. No token or local install needed.
